tiebreakers.description: Most points in a single ingredient column
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: set-collection. Game ends when a player plays their 11th card; finish the round (through the player to the Ancestor's right) then everyone plays one final turn. Each card's points depend on the ingredient icons in the potion (card shows own points, or points per count/set of ingredients), so per-column totals are scorer inputs. Double cards = 2 ingredients, Salt = +1 of the ingredient it is stacked on, Bonus Ingredient tokens = +1 ingredient. Solo variants are unofficial and not modelled. Rulebook not downloaded; verified from RulesPal text of the rulebook only.
